name: Grillo.Racing (patch 1.2)
author: saggio_grillo
description:
COMMANDS:
- To move you have to use "WASD"
- By pressing the "space" key the car will slowly reverse (for drifting)
- By pressing the up arrow, the car rises slightly
- By pressing the left and right arrow the car will tip over to the side     
PATCH 1.2 NEW CHANGES:                                                                                     - Two floors of the Grillo-tower have been added                                                - In a few days a mini update will be released that will fix some of the most 
annoying bugs of patch 1.2, stay strong and see you soon.                                      - Uga uga
